Coefficients and sources of the four methods of
[Stepping and error control](methods-stepping.html), selected by `method`
and `useNDF` of [`cppODE()`](../reference/cppODE.html). Symbols follow the
[notation table](methods-overview.html#notation).

## BDF and NDF coefficients {#bdf-coeffs}

*Source.* Shampine and Reichelt [@MATLABODESuite, Table 1]; implemented in
`cppde_multistepper.hpp`.

The NDF of order $q$ adds to the BDF$q$ corrector a term proportional to
the Nordsieck predictor error,
[]{#eq-ndf}
$$
  \sum_{m=1}^{q} \frac{1}{m}\, \nabla^{m} x_{n+1}
  \;-\; h_n\, f(x_{n+1}, t_{n+1})
  \;-\; \kappa_q\, H_q\, \bigl(x_{n+1} - x_{n+1}^{\mathrm{pred}}\bigr)
  \;=\; 0,
  \qquad
  H_q \;=\; \sum_{m=1}^{q} \tfrac{1}{m}, \tag{1}
$$
with $\nabla$ the backward-difference operator; $\kappa_q = 0$ gives
BDF$q$. `useNDF` (default `TRUE`) selects NDF or BDF at compile time.

| $q$ | $\kappa_q$ | step-size gain over BDF$q$ | stability angle |
|:--|--:|:--|:--|
| 1 | -0.1850 | $+26\,\%$ | A-stable |
| 2 | -0.1111 | $+26\,\%$ | A-stable |
| 3 | -0.0823 | $+26\,\%$ | $80^\circ$ |
| 4 | -0.0415 | $+12\,\%$ | $66^\circ$ |
| 5 | 0.0000 | $0\,\%$ | $51^\circ$ ($=$ BDF5) |

Table: NDF coefficients $\kappa_q$ of cppDE, empirical step-size gain over BDF$q$ at matched local error, and stability angle. NDF5 is BDF5, since the BDF5 angle of $51^\circ$ leaves no room for reduction.

## Adams-Moulton coefficients {#adams-coeffs}

*Source.* Hindmarsh et al. [@hindmarsh2005sundials], the
$\ell$-vector formulation of CVODE; implemented in
`cppde_multistepper.hpp` by `adams_set_coefficients()`.

The coefficients depend on the past step sizes and are recomputed every
step. With $\xi_j = (t_{n+1} - t_{n+1-j})/h_n$, the correction vector
$(\ell_0, \dots, \ell_q)$ of the Nordsieck array holds the coefficients of
the polynomial $\Lambda(u) = \sum_{j=0}^{q} \ell_j u^j$ with
$$
  \Lambda(-1) \;=\; 0,
  \qquad
  \Lambda(0) \;=\; 1,
  \qquad
  \Lambda'(u) \;\propto\; \prod_{j=1}^{q-1} \bigl(1 + u/\xi_j\bigr),
$$
and the weight of the implicit term is $\beta_0 = 1/\ell_1$. At constant
step size the corrector weights $\beta_0, \dots, \beta_q$ are the
fixed-step values of [@hairer2008solving, Table III.1.1]. The controller selects
$q \in \{1, \dots, 12\}$; $q_{\max} = 12$ is the CVODE default.

## Rosenbrock4 coefficients {#ros-coeffs}

*Source.* Hairer and Wanner [@hairer2010solving, §IV.7], the default
coefficients of the `rosenbrock4` stepper of
Boost.Numeric.Odeint except the sign of $d_4$, which is that of
`rodas.f`; implemented in
`default_rosenbrock_coefficients` in
`cppde_rosenbrock4.hpp`.

With $W = (\gamma h_n)^{-1} I - J(x_n, t_n)$, the stage equations are
$$
\begin{aligned}
W\, k_i
  &\;=\; f\!\left(x_n + \sum_{j<i} \alpha_{ij}\, k_j,\;
                 t_n + c_i\, h_n \right)
        \;+\; \frac{1}{h_n} \sum_{j<i} \gamma_{ij}\, k_j
        \;+\; h_n\, d_i\, \frac{\partial f}{\partial t}, \\
x_{n+1}      &\;=\; x_n + \sum_{i=1}^{s} m_i\, k_i,
   \qquad
\hat x_{n+1} \;=\; x_n + \sum_{i=1}^{s} \hat m_i\, k_i.
\end{aligned}
$$
cppDE uses $s = 6$ and $\gamma = 1/4$, indexed as in the source.

|  |  |  |  |  |  |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| $\gamma$ | 0.25 | $d_1$ | 0.25 | $c_2$ | 0.386 |
| $d_2$ | $-0.1043$ | $d_3$ | 0.1035 | $c_3$ | 0.21 |
| $d_4$ | $-0.0362$ |  |  | $c_4$ | 0.63 |

Table: Rosenbrock4 diagonal coefficient $\gamma$, time-partial coefficients $d_i$, nodes $c_i$.

|  | $j=1$ | $j=2$ | $j=3$ | $j=4$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| $\alpha_{2,j}$ | 1.5440000000 |  |  |  |
| $\alpha_{3,j}$ | 0.9466785281 | 0.2557011699 |  |  |
| $\alpha_{4,j}$ | 3.3148251871 | 2.8961240160 | 0.9986419140 |  |
| $\alpha_{5,j}$ | 1.2212245092 | 6.0191344813 | 12.5370833293 | -0.6878860361 |

Table: Rosenbrock4 stage couplings $\alpha_{ij}$: row $i$ the stage formed, column $j$ an earlier stage.

|  | $j=1$ | $j=2$ | $j=3$ | $j=4$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| $\gamma_{2,j}$ | -5.6688000000 |  |  |  |
| $\gamma_{3,j}$ | -2.4300933568 | -0.2063599157 |  |  |
| $\gamma_{4,j}$ | -0.1073529058 | -9.5945622510 | -20.4702861481 |  |
| $\gamma_{5,j}$ | 7.4964433140 | -10.2468043146 | -33.9999035282 | 11.7089089321 |

Table: Rosenbrock4 stage couplings $\gamma_{ij}$ of the term $(1/h_n)\sum_{j<i}\gamma_{ij}\,k_j$, indexed as $\alpha_{ij}$.

The sixth stage, at the embedded order-$3$ solution $X_6$, is the error
estimate $e_{n+1}$, which the step solution adds to $X_6$:
$$
  X_6 \;=\; x_n + \sum_{i=1}^{5} \alpha_{6,i}\, k_i,
  \qquad
  W\, e_{n+1} \;=\; f(X_6,\, t_n + h_n) + \frac{1}{h_n}\sum_{i=1}^{5} \gamma_{6,i}\, k_i,
  \qquad
  x_{n+1} \;=\; X_6 + e_{n+1},
$$
with the sixth-row coefficients

|  | $i=1$ | $i=2$ | $i=3$ | $i=4$ | $i=5$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| $\alpha_{6,i}$ | 1.2212245092 | 6.0191344813 | 12.5370833293 | -0.6878860361 | 1.0 |
| $\gamma_{6,i}$ | 8.0832467959 | -7.9811329881 | -31.5215943287 | 16.3193054312 | -6.0588182388 |

Table: Rosenbrock4 sixth-row coefficients: $\alpha_{6,i}$ form $X_6$, $\gamma_{6,i}$ enter the error estimate $e_{n+1}$.

The order-$3$ interpolant on $[t_n, t_{n+1}]$ combines the five stages
and the step solution.

|  | $i=1$ | $i=2$ | $i=3$ | $i=4$ | $i=5$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| $d_i^{(2)}$ | 10.1262350834 | -7.4879958776 | -34.8009186156 | -7.9927717076 | 1.0251377233 |
| $d_i^{(3)}$ | -0.6762803393 | 6.0877146517 | 16.4308432089 | 24.7672251142 | -6.5943891257 |

Table: Rosenbrock4 dense-output coefficients $d_i^{(2)}$ and $d_i^{(3)}$.

## Tsitouras 5(4) coefficients {#tsit5-coeffs}

*Source.* Tsitouras [@TSITOURAS2011770, Table 1 and eqs. (7), (8)];
implemented in `cppde_tsit5.hpp`.

The pair has $s = 7$ stages and satisfies the first column simplifying
assumption $\sum_i b_i a_{ij} = b_j(1 - c_j)$ for every $j$, but not the
row condition $\sum_j a_{ij} c_j = c_i^2/2$. The seventh stage is the
FSAL stage: row $a_{7,j}$ equals $b_j$ for $j = 1, \dots, 6$.

| $i$ | $c_i$ | $a_{i1}$ | $a_{i2}$ | $a_{i3}$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 1 | 0 |  |  |  |
| 2 | 0.161 | 0.161 |  |  |
| 3 | 0.327 | -0.0084806555 | 0.3354806555 |  |
| 4 | 0.9 | 2.8971530571 | -6.3594484900 | 4.3622954329 |
| 5 | 0.9800255409 | 5.3258648284 | -11.7488835641 | 7.4955393429 |
| 6 | 1.0 | 5.8614554429 | -12.9209693178 | 8.1593678986 |
| 7 | 1.0 | 0.0964607668 | 0.01 | 0.4798896504 |

Table: Tsitouras 5(4) nodes $c_i$ and coefficients $a_{i1}$ to $a_{i3}$.

| $i$ | $a_{i4}$ | $a_{i5}$ | $a_{i6}$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| 5 | -0.0924950664 |  |  |
| 6 | -0.0715849733 | -0.0282690504 |  |
| 7 | 1.3790085741 | -3.2900695154 | 2.3247105241 |

Table: Tsitouras 5(4) coefficients $a_{i4}$ to $a_{i6}$, nonzero from row $5$ on. Row $7$ of both tables is $b_j$ (FSAL).

$k_7 = f(x_{n+1},\, t_n + h_n)$ is $k_1$ of step $n+1$. With $b_7 = 0$
and $\hat b_7 \neq 0$, it enters the order-$4$ estimate only. The
controller uses
$$
  e_{n+1} \;=\; h_n \sum_{i=1}^{7} (\hat b_i - b_i)\, k_i.
$$

| $i$ | $b_i$ | $\hat b_i$ | $\hat b_i - b_i$ |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| 1 | 0.0964607668 | 0.0946807557 | -0.0017800111 |
| 2 | 0.01 | 0.0091835655 | -0.0008164345 |
| 3 | 0.4798896504 | 0.4877705284 | 0.0078808780 |
| 4 | 1.3790085741 | 1.2342975669 | -0.1447110072 |
| 5 | -3.2900695154 | -2.7077123499 | 0.5823571655 |
| 6 | 2.3247105241 | 1.8666284182 | -0.4580821059 |
| 7 | 0 | 0.0151515152 | 0.0151515152 |
